subject: Post-demo procurement checkpoints & next steps — HealthGrid
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + procurement checkpoints after today's demo

Hi Sophie — great demo earlier, thanks again for the time. Quick recap and a few operational questions so we can get you a clean procurement path: 

Summary from our side:
- Core ask: host patient-facing summarization pipeline with private deployment in your VPC; steady-state ~30 req/s, spiky bursts to 90 req/s.
- Compliance gating: your security team flagged SOC 2 Type 2, DPA, and a short vendor security questionnaire as blockers for procurement sign-off.

Questions / asks for next steps:
1) Preferred purchase route: PO (paperflow) vs corporate card vs vendor marketplace? Which would expedite approval for HealthGrid?
2) Who should we work with on your side for contract/paperflow (procurement contact + email)?
3) Timeline target for SOC 2 & DPA review internally — any particular deadlines we should align to?

I've cc'd Ben from Commercial to outline pricing/PO flow and Marissa from Legal to surface DPA/SOC2 artifacts. We'll attach the SOC2 report and a draft DPA for your review in the next email.

If easier, I can schedule a 30-minute procurement sync with your procurement lead + our legal/commercial folks.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai
From: Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:19:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + procurement checkpoints after today's demo

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the demo walkthrough; your latency numbers look promising. Answers inline: 

1) Preferred purchase route: PO preferred — our finance team requires a PO for any vendor with data residency implications. Marketplace is possible but adds extra procurement steps here, so PO will be fastest.
2) Procurement contact: please loop in our Sr. Procurement Manager, Alex Mercer (alex.mercer@healthgrid.com). Procurement inbox is procure@healthgrid.com.
3) Timeline: target is to have DPA and security review completed by end of calendar Q1 2027 (we have a vendor intake meeting 2027-01-12 where decisions are tabled). 

I'll have Alex coordinate the paperwork and share any internal checklist. Also, our security team asked specifically for: SOC 2 Type 2 report, proof of encryption-at-rest (KMS/HSM summary), and a completed vendor questionnaire.

Sophie
Sophie Lane | Head of Integrations | HealthGrid
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + procurement checkpoints after today's demo

Thanks Sophie — Ben here (Commercial Ops). Quick notes on the PO/paperflow and options to speed things up: 

- PO (standard): we can issue a proforma invoice and accept a net-30/45 PO. If HealthGrid needs a corporate contract signature first, we can route through DocuSign.
- Card: we can accept card for first-month pilot but understand your policy prefers PO for production.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on both CloudMarket A and GovCloudMarketplace; if HealthGrid prefers marketplace procurement we can provide a vendor listing and price catalog, but that typically adds 2–3 weeks.

Actionables I can own:
- Provide PO-ready invoice and outline billing contact fields.
- Share the minimum contract terms that require procurement/legal attention (I'll attach a redline summary).

I'll attach a short procurement checklist in the next note and loop Marissa for legal/DPA items.

Ben Carter | Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@healthgrid.com>, Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + procurement checkpoints after today's demo

Hi Alex / Sophie — Marissa on Legal. Attaching our SOC2 Type 2 report (redacted) and a draft DPA for your review. Key notes up-front: 

- Data processing: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) for private deployments; details are called out in Exhibit A of the DPA.
- Certificate/attestations: SOC2 report is attached; for on-prem/VPC deployments we can offer an attestation letter about isolation controls if required.
- Questionnaire: please use the link below to submit your vendor security questionnaire — we can respond within 3 business days for standard items and up to 10 business days for infra-level deep dives.

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf, Redwood-DPA-draft.docx

Security questionnaire: https://forms.redwood.ai/security-questionnaire/HG-2026-11

If you'd like, we can schedule a short technical breakout with our infra engineer to answer deep dive questions (esp. KMS/HSM and network isolation).

Thanks — Marissa Cole | Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@healthgrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>, Procurement Team <procure@healthgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement checkpoints & next steps — HealthGrid

Marissa / team — thanks for the attachments. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

1) PO workflow — send us a PO-ready invoice template with the following fields populated: legal entity, remit-to address, tax ID, line items (monthly committed capacity + overage), and contact for billing.
2) DPA redlines — we have a few standard edits around breach notification timing and data deletion timelines; our legal ops will push those in a redline PDF.
3) Marketplace — we may request marketplace listing only after initial contract; for speed we'll start with PO.

Timeline: we aim to finish commercial terms and security questionnaire by 2027-01-10 to present at the vendor intake on 2027-01-12. Procurement contact: procure@healthgrid.com.

I'll have our legal ops send the redline and the vendor questionnaire to your security link.

Alex Mercer | Sr. Procurement Manager | HealthGrid
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@healthgrid.com>, Sophie Lane <s.lane@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement checkpoints & next steps — HealthGrid

Perfect — thanks Alex. Next steps on our side (owner in parentheses):
- Ben: send PO-ready invoice template and billing fields today (Ben).
- Marissa: await redline, will incorporate common edits and return an updated DPA (Marissa).
- Jordan: schedule a 30-minute procurement sync with Alex + our billing/legal for Thurs 2026-12-17 10:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.
- HealthGrid: submit vendor questionnaire via the link and share redline ahead of the intake meeting (Alex/Sophie).

If anything shifts on timing, flag here and we'll reprioritize.

Thanks all — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
